issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the method with return type double (+getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double on line 72), but the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() (line 85) and returns an int (integer division). This mismatch leaves students unclear which return type to implement and whether fractional students-per-tutor values are expected; it can cause failing tests or incorrect calculations if the wrong type is used.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the method signature and implementation to return a double and perform floating-point division. For example: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } If integer division was intended instead, update the problem statement/UML to indicate an int return type; prefer changing the implementation to double to preserve fractional results as specified by the UML.
